Test Requirements
GRE not required
Letters of Recommendation 3
International Applicants Only TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo English Test score (no more than two years old)
Other Requirements In addition to the University’s required application materials, applicants should review the information below for additional expectations or application requirements.
PHD
An acceptable bachelor’s degree with mathematics training at least including multivariable calculus and linear algebra. Real analysis (advanced calculus) is strongly encouraged.
MS
An acceptable bachelor’s degree with mathematics training at least including multivariable calculus and linear algebra.
Statement of Purpose
Statement of purpose that should include why and or how you became interested in Biostatistics. It would also be helpful to discuss research and work experience relevant to your proposed plan of study.
*Consultation with the Director of Graduate Admissions will be required in order to be considered for admission in any semester other than Fall.
